comparison_level: For named wrappers, all 16 GPRs, SR, PR, PC, FPUL, complete FPU banks and FPSCR are checked. Both named routines are tested for all 65,536 phases; outputs satisfy the SH-4 FSCA absolute-error bound against the mathematical result. Callback integration tests retain injected FSCA values.
scope: Two whole retail entry spans: unsigned16 phase masking, LDS FPUL, FSCA result and inexact status, RTS return PC, and cosine FR1-to-FR0 delay behavior. Full phase-space tests vary FR bank, SZ and RM; PR=1 and enabled-inexact cases exercise explicit unsupported/trap statuses.
limitations: The implementation uses a software polynomial meeting the documented FSCA error bound; bit-exact SH7091 hardware output has not been measured.
Enabled inexact and PR=1 exception vector dispatch is not implemented; these cases return explicit status while preserving destination registers.
